2378-2790.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
Angel of Destiny does not have summoning sickness.
2378-2790.notablePrerequisites:
You control three other creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
Creatures your opponents control cannot block this turn.
2378-2790.description:
Cast Mirrorweave by paying its mana cost, targeting Angel of Destiny and causing each other creature in play to become a copy of the targeted creature until end of turn.
Move to combat and declare all your Angels as attackers, sending at least one Angel at each opponent.
When first strike damage is dealt, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers for each creature that dealt damage.
Resolve each trigger, causing each opponent to gain life equal to X times the damage they took (where X is the number of Angels you control) and you to gain life equal to that combined total.
Repeat steps 4-5 for the normal damage step.
At the beginning of your end step, since your life total is at least 45, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers, causing the player it attacked to lose the game.

2511-2586-7690--165.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat

539-728-801-3249.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-801-3249.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

586-728-5258-5618-6556.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4247-7192.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2292-2738-4556-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Blight Mound, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4359-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2043-3621-4050.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

661-2146-3685-4659.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Cloud Key. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3459-5078-6006-6766.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3108-4050-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
3108-4050-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

280-4572-5702-6664.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-4572-5702-6664.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

2034-4268-4593-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-4268-4593-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

4017-4186-5070.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-4186-5070.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1909-4486-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Arbor Adherent that has its toughness boosted by at least 1.
1909-4486-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.
1909-4486-6478.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

1778-2921-5220-5683.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Memnite from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Memnite and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

413-914-3719.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
413-914-3719.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure token, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

486-1543-3666-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Nissa has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
486-1543-3666-4312.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Nissa to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Nissa.
Activate Nissa by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

524-3263-4376.description:
Aether Storm prevents creature spells from being cast.
Because Damping Matrix prevents Aether Storm's activated ability from being activated, it cannot be destroyed due to its ability.

396-1409-2034-3263.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
396-1409-2034-3263.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {2}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability and Blessed Sanctuary triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and another creature you control.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Unicorn, adding {2}.
Repeat.

169-2825-3152-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
169-2825-3152-5147.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {0} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pact of the Titan without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Resolve Pact of the Titan, creating a 4/4 Giant creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Giant, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2634-4191-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2634-4191-4821.description:
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve the Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Cast Rootha by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat from step 2.
If nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1434-1585-5203.description:
Cast In Bolas's Clutches by {4}{U}{U}, targeting any permanent on the battlefield.
Holding priority, cast Radiant Performer by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Radiant Performer enters the battlefield, creating a copy of In Bolas's Clutches for each other permanent on the battlefield.
Resolve each In Bolas's Clutches, causing you to gain control of all permanents.

2557-3423-4541.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight Treasure tokens.
2557-3423-4541.description:
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}.
Cast Marut by paying {8}.
Marut enters the battlefield, creating sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Aegis Automaton by paying {4}{W}, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
